note: How residents react to the weather (F-NPC-REACT level 1; LIVING_CITY CITY-077 to CITY-080). Read by Tools/citysim/citysim.py through Tools/worldgen/world.py; checked by world.react_problems. Every chance is from 0 to 1 and is drawn once per resident per day, so what someone wears and carries never changes during the day.

umbrella.note: Someone takes an umbrella out with them when the day has rain in it (they saw the forecast), and now and then on a dry day.

coat.note: season: the chance of a coat on a dry day, by season (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter). rain_day: at least this chance when the day has rain. hood: the share of coats with a hood.

shelter.note: When rain starts, people out in the open stop what they are doing within notice_minutes and make for cover: one of `to` (the resident's nearest one; 'home' is home), chosen per resident per spell. They wait there until the rain stops, then go back to what they were doing if at least resume_minutes of it are left.

pace.note: Walking speed in rain, as a share of the resident's own pace. run: running for cover with no umbrella. hurry: walking in rain with no umbrella. umbrella: walking in rain under one.
